source.title: Applications for WCA Continental Championships 2026 (July 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,
The WCA Board of Directors and Major Championship Team are excited to open bids for 2026 Continental Championships to be selected per procedures in [Motion 22.2024.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2024.1%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Selection.pdf). We would like to receive applications for the following regions for 2026 Continental Championships:

* Africa
* Asia
* North America
* Oceania
* South America

If you are interested in hosting one of these championships, please discuss with your country’s Delegates and Regional Organization. Please note that organizing a continental championship is a significant time commitment. Applications must be endorsed by a [WCA Recognized Regional Organization](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations). (Note: The WCA Board has proposed a change to Motion 22.2024.1, to accept applications from registered entities in regions not represented by a Regional Organization)

If you are interested, please send your application documents to[ assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org), and [championships@worldcubeassociation.org](maito:championships@worldcubeassociation.org), before August 31st, 2025, 23:59 UTC. Applications must contain the subject line “< Location/Team > bid for < Continent > Championship 2026”. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details (if any) removed to make public.

<!-- break -->

At a minimum, your application needs to address:

1. **When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2026**
   - a. Possible dates.
   - b. Number of days of the competition.
   - c. Overlap with local school holiday periods.

2. **Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship in your country?**
   - a. City should be interesting to visit with ample sightseeing opportunities.
   - b. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
   - c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
   - d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
   - e. Technology available including internet capabilities, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
   - f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

3. **What would the organization team and competition volunteer look like?**
   - a. Core team members
   - b. Experience of the core team.
   - c. Involvement of other parties.
   - d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should be volunteers).
   - e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

4. **What would be the competition budget?**
   - a. Costs (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/gift packs, prizes).
    - b. Income (registration fees, local government). 
        - Note: Your proposed budget *should not assume* any financial sponsorship from the WCA.

Previous public versions of Continental and Worlds Championship bid documents are contained in [this folder.](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QJvZQ7mzQh2qA65d0d9ay3mWWFBXN9MR?usp=sharing) [This Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FqlvtRb1EWz8ZuXwMOB0zOv307LDpJpDt3WsoY9m7VQ/edit?usp=sharing) contains a fairly comprehensive list of topics that should be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

We encourage all organization teams to reach out to WMCT. We are happy to answer questions, provide advice, or offer further resources to aid with your bid.

Once applications are closed, the WCA Board will appoint a selection committee, interview shortlisted applicants and vote in order to decide where the 2026 Continental Championships will take place.

We look forward to receiving your bid!

translation.title: 2026 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛申办（2025 年 7 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 董事会与大型锦标赛团队很高兴宣布，2026 年洲际锦标赛申办现已开放。举办地将按[决议 22.2024.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2024.1%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Selection.pdf)规定的流程选定。我们现征集以下地区的 2026 年洲际锦标赛申办方案：

* 非洲
* 亚洲
* 北美洲
* 大洋洲
* 南美洲

如有意申办，请先与所在国家的代表及地区组织商议。举办洲际锦标赛需要投入大量时间，请充分考虑。申请须获得 [WCA 认可地区组织](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations)的支持。（注：WCA 董事会已提议修改决议 22.2024.1，允许尚无地区组织覆盖的地区由注册实体提交申请。）

有意者请于 2025 年 8 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料发送至 [assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)、[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org) 和 [championships@worldcubeassociation.org](maito:championships@worldcubeassociation.org)。邮件主题须为“< Location/Team > bid for < Continent > Championship 2026”（即“<地点/团队>申办 2026 年<洲名>锦标赛”）。申请材料须为 PDF 格式，提供两个版本：包含全部申办细节的完整版，以及删去敏感信息（如有）、可供公开的版本。

<!-- break -->

申请至少应说明以下内容：

1. **计划何时举办 2026 年洲际锦标赛？**
   - a. 可选日期。
   - b. 比赛天数。
   - c. 是否与当地学校假期重合。

2. **计划在贵国的什么地点举办洲际锦标赛？**
   - a. 城市应具有旅游吸引力，并有充足的观光选择。
   - b. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度。
   - c. 不同价位酒店或公寓的供应情况。
   - d. 场馆、面积及布置（舞台、观众区、练习桌、附属房间）。
   - e. 可用技术设施，包括网络、视频直播、灯光和音响设备。
   - f. 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

3. **组织团队与比赛志愿者如何安排？**
   - a. 核心团队成员。
   - b. 核心团队的经验。
   - c. 其他参与方。
   - d. 当地志愿者的数量与能力（建议志愿者人数达到选手人数的 20%）。
   - e. 需要国外代表提供哪些支持。

4. **比赛预算如何安排？**
   - a. 支出：场地、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、证件/挂绳/礼包及奖品。
   - b. 收入：报名费、当地政府支持。
     - 注意：拟定预算时，*不得预设*会获得 WCA 的资金赞助。

历届洲际锦标赛和世界锦标赛申办材料的公开版本见[此文件夹](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QJvZQ7mzQh2qA65d0d9ay3mWWFBXN9MR?usp=sharing)。[这份表格](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FqlvtRb1EWz8ZuXwMOB0zOv307LDpJpDt3WsoY9m7VQ/edit?usp=sharing)较全面地列出了大型比赛需要安排和纳入预算的事项。

欢迎各组织团队联系 WMCT。我们很乐意回答问题、提供建议或其他资料，协助你们准备申办。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将任命遴选委员会，对入围申请方进行面谈，并通过投票决定 2026 年各洲际锦标赛的举办地。

期待收到你们的申办方案！
